integrity: The incidence reduction is proved by line-pair counting and Bezout. The Jacobian-syzygy upper and lower bounds and the numerical near-freeness identity are replayed exactly by the bundled symbolic verifier.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to one smooth conic and four lines with exactly two nodes, no tacnodes, and four ordinary triple points.
The parameter lambda is only a normal-form coordinate modulo the finite anharmonic action, not a fine-moduli coordinate.
Literature noncoverage is limited to the inspected sources and recorded searches.
title: Uniform near freeness on the four-chord conic stratum
